description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between BLEU score and average lagging (AL) for three different models: Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, and Inconsistency-CE-MP. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)", ranges from 2.5 to 10.0, with tick marks at intervals of 2.5, and is presented on a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU", ranges from 25 to 33, with tick marks at intervals of 1, also on a linear scale. The legend identifies three distinct lines: Consistency-CE is represented by a light purple line with circular markers; Inconsistency-CE is shown as a dark purple line with square markers; and Inconsistency-CE-MP is depicted as a red line with star markers. All three lines exhibit a general upward trend, indicating that BLEU scores increase as average lagging increases. At an AL of 2.5, the BLEU scores are approximately 26.0 for Consistency-CE, 26.5 for Inconsistency-CE, and 26.5 for Inconsistency-CE-MP. As AL increases to 10.0, the BLEU scores rise to approximately 31.5 for Consistency-CE, 31.5 for Inconsistency-CE, and 32.0 for Inconsistency-CE-MP. The Inconsistency-CE-MP line consistently shows the highest BLEU score across the entire range of AL values.
